title: Floor plan template and room labels
subject: Arabic
unit: Spring 1: My new home; my room and furniture; describing my appearance and clothes
source: Written for arabic/y5 lesson 5 (Floor plan template and room labels (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 5: My new home: the rooms. Read the Arabic aloud, then do the tasks. Write in Arabic with all the harakat.

panels.title: In my house there is
points: In my house there is a kitchen

panels.title: My new home
points: بَيْتِي جَدِيدٌ (bayti jadidun) my house is new

panels.title: How many rooms?
points: In my house there are three rooms

box.title: Draw a floor plan of a home (rooms only, no people). Stick or write a room label in each room.

questions.q: Say: In my house there is a garden.
Core: Draw a simple floor plan of a home (boxes) and label each room in Arabic.
questions.a: Plan labelled with مَطْبَخ، حَمَّام، غُرْفَةُ النَّوْمِ، غُرْفَةُ الجُلُوسِ، حَدِيقَة

questions.q: Extend: Write three sentences: فِي بَيْتِي ...
questions.a: For example: فِي بَيْتِي مَطْبَخٌ. فِي بَيْتِي حَمَّامٌ. فِي بَيْتِي حَدِيقَةٌ.

questions.q: Stretch: Write how many rooms your home has, e.g. فِي بَيْتِي أَرْبَعُ غُرَفٍ.
questions.a: For example: فِي بَيْتِي أَرْبَعُ غُرَفٍ.
B) kitchen. مَطْبَخ comes from طَبَخَ, to cook: the kitchen.

questions.q: What is حَدِيقَة? A) garden B) kitchen C) room
Big question: describe your home in one Arabic sentence.
questions.a: For example: بَيْتِي كَبِيرٌ وَفِيهِ حَدِيقَةٌ.
